issue_request: FHIR-47674 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked to correct ImagingStudy.series because its 0..* cardinality permits ordered or scheduled studies with no started series, so the short and definition should no longer say "one or more" series.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 3c1b0a1ea24f081df705a92f7d4c36904ac56a43, "FHIR-47674 - ImagingStudy.series", which changed source/imagingstudy/structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml from the old "one or more" short/definition to the approved wording. The Jira comment points to HL7/fhir#3319, merged by 34c21d3320791eccd74e38ecdf9079268382a2e1.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ImagingStudy as an active resource and approved artifact, so source/imagingstudy/structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml is current build-scope source. A checked-in source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy.svg tooltip still contains the old sentence, but it is a generated-looking diagram artifact; the operating guardrail says not to publish a source-changing reconciliation when the only remaining mismatch is such an SVG and the authoritative XML source is correct.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current XML source has the approved short "The set of Series belonging to the study" and definition "The set of Series belonging to the study. Each Series contains a set of SOP Instances, which could be images, waveforms, or other content."
